name: EmptyRecycleBin
label: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Deletes all files from the Windows recycle bin for all users or current user.

fields.name: Scope
fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Specifies whether to empty the recycle bin for all users (requires admin privileges) or just the current user.

selectOptions.label: Current User
selectOptions.description: Empty only the current user's recycle bin.

selectOptions.label: All Users
selectOptions.description: Empty recycle bins for all users (requires admin privileges).
